[[File:Travon.png|thumb|250px|Travon]] '''Travon''' (Japanese: '''トクゾー''' ''Tokuzō'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[BW113|The Light of Floccesy Ranch!]]''. He is [[Ellie]]'s grandfather, and he helps her while working at [[Floccesy Ranch]]. When he met with {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}, Travon allowed them to stay over since they were Trainers. When the {{p|Mareep}} in the farm went missing due to {{TRT}}'s machine, he did not trust Ampharos being an efficient guard Pokémon anymore. However, Travon changed his mind once Ampharos mastered {{m|Thunder Punch}}.
